newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates- Quoted at flat to higher levels.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates- Quoted at flat to higher levels.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to higher levels Friday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session.
No barges traded versus none Thursday.
- 10 barges, St Paul-Savage, upper Mississippi River, two each week of June, bid 135 percent of tariff, up five percentage points from May 15, no offer.
- 10 barges, Mid-Mississippi, two each week of June, bid 105 percent, unchanged from May 14, offer 115 percent.
- Five barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of August, bid 115 percent, unchanged from May 15, offer 122-1/2 percent, no comparison.
- Four barges, Mid-Mississippi, one each week of September, bid 157-1/2 percent, up 2-1/2 percentage points from May 15, no offer.
